children: RBC Capital Markets raised its price target on Qualcomm
to $180 from $160 after the chipmaker's agreement with Amazon, saying the relationship could give Qualcomm a stronger position in the data-center AI market.

Analyst Srini Pajjuri kept a Sector Perform rating but highlighted the potential scale of Amazon's commitments. The arrangement covers Qualcomm server processors, related technology and manufacturing services, with purchase commitments and payments potentially reaching $60 billion.

RBC estimates the opportunity could eventually generate about $6 billion in additional annual revenue over the next decade if all related milestones are achieved. The forecast compares with Qualcomm's earlier data-center revenue targets of about $300 million for fiscal 2026 and $5 billion for fiscal 2027.

Pajjuri also pointed to Amazon as one of Qualcomm's major hyperscaler customers, potentially giving the company a path into custom AI silicon. Revenue from the relationship is expected to begin in the December 2026 quarter, with some programs already in production.

title: Veteran Bank Revamps Qualcomm Price Target After Amazon AI Chip Deal
